description_en: Quries the endpoint information for a cloud service
description_zh: 获取产品的接入点信息
name: GetProductEndpoints

parameters.help_en:
The product code. You can find it in two ways:

Call the `GetRequestLog` operation. The product code will be included in the response data.

The product code is the last part of the service's URL in OpenAPI Explorer. For example, <props="china">the OpenAPI Explorer URL for Short Message Service is https\://api.aliyun.com/product/Dysmsapi. Therefore, the product code is Dysmsapi.</props><props="intl">the OpenAPI Explorer URL for Short Message Service is https\://api.alibabacloud.com/product/Dysmsapi. Therefore, the product code is Dysmsapi.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
产品CODE。

调用GetRequestLog接口，从返回结果中获取产品CODE。

通过OpenAPI门户的URL，找到对应的产品CODE。例如，<props="china">短信服务的OpenAPI门户URL为https://api.aliyun.com/product/Dysmsapi，根据该URL获取短信服务的产品CODE为Dysmsapi。</props>
<props="intl">短信服务的OpenAPI门户URL为https://api.alibabacloud.com/product/Dysmsapi，根据该URL获取短信服务的产品CODE为Dysmsapi。</props>
parameters.name: product
